scope: Independent read-only review of the exact C12 local snapshot: durable password-reset authorization requires the actor exact tenant and workspace membership, with a sibling-workspace denial regression against unit fakes and live PostgreSQL.
acceptance_criteria: Every volatile admin create, update, deactivate and reset operation is scoped to the actor exact tenant and workspace; sibling-workspace actors cannot mutate a target or its state.

Durable password reset retains the global account lock and cross-tenant guard, but requires target membership in the actor exact tenant and workspace before changing global credentials, revoking sessions or writing outbox events.
Unit and real PostgreSQL sibling-workspace reset attempts are forbidden and leave password/version, sessions and audit outbox unchanged; same-workspace reset remains successful.
Volatile creation uses the actor workspace; unsupported workspace transfer is rejected; rejected operations do not partially mutate records.
Last-active-administrator demotion and deactivation protection counts administrators only in the exact actor workspace and remains correct under concurrent local mutations.

Deactivation changes only the selected membership, preserves global account status and credentials, revokes only sessions bound to that tenant/workspace, and leaves sibling memberships/sessions unchanged.

Session validation resolves the exact tenant/workspace membership, accepts active sessions in multiple workspaces of one tenant, rejects mismatches/inactive memberships, and defaults a legacy session with no workspace_id to the documented default scope.
PostgreSQL recovery locks the global account and exact membership in a consistent order, verifies active membership under lock, and updates credentials plus session revocation in one transaction.

Real PostgreSQL concurrency evidence shows recovery and deactivation serialize correctly; replay and inactive-membership failures do not commit password/session side effects or consume a token on rollback.
The admin API exposes membership status separately from global account status, and the UI renders inactive membership/action state correctly with regression coverage.
Listed evidence and provenance substantiate this exact local snapshot only; production, product, release and promotion acceptance remain open.

limitations: Scoped local evidence in a dirty shared checkout. API route authentication uses test dependency overrides and does not prove deployed authentication. The in-memory adapter stores one membership per user and its RLock coordinates only threads in one process; PostgreSQL is the durable multi-workspace path. Integrated production worker/runtime, operational monitoring and recovery, provider/model/corpus acceptance, representative RAG quality, visual/accessibility, release and promotion remain open.
